note: Chapter 1 is keyed from 'Italy break' (the ball won, Totti's pass) through 'Gilardino slips' (the pass across) to 'goal' (the ball in the top corner): keep the pause at '...' so the break plays near real time. Chapter 2 whips up the pitch just after 'sprinted'. Chapter 3's curl plays in slow motion between 'high' and 'top corner'.

chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Dortmund, 2006. Italy against Germany, the last minute of extra time. Italy break! Gilardino races forward, and Alessandro Del Piero sprints to join him. Gilardino slips it across... goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again. As soon as Italy won the ball, Del Piero sprinted to support, so Gilardino had a friend to pass to.

chapters.label: Into the corner
chapters.text: He curls it high past keeper Jens Lehmann, into the top corner. Italy are in the final!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: when your team wins the ball, sprint forward to support, then bend it into the far corner.
